spec.name: guy_cable_anchor
spec.description: Guy-cable anchor block, 100 x 60 x 60 mm, y up. Bottom face fully bolted. A 5 kN cable pull acts on a 16 mm diameter boss at the centre of the top face, inclined 3:4 (rise:run). The horizontal run is taken along +x, the long axis, giving 4 kN horizontal and 3 kN upward.

supports.note: Bottom face y=0 bolted down over its full area

loads.note: 5 kN along the cable direction (4,3,0)/5. The cable rises 3 per 4 horizontal, giving 4 kN in +x and 3 kN in +y. It acts on a 16 mm diameter boss face at the top-face centre (x=50, z=30). The horizontal direction is assumed to be +x.

passive.note: Keeps the loaded 16 mm boss face solid

assumptions: The cable's horizontal component is taken along +x, the long axis; the brief does not specify the horizontal direction.
The cable pulls the anchor upward and away, since it rises from the anchor.
